summary: Fraudsters posing as Bluerock Wealth crypto advisors targeted a senior victim with fake passive income promises remote desktop guidance and a fabricated trading platform showing false profits before stealing 650000 dollars and demanding additional recovery fees. The scheme used fake bonuses withdrawal obstruction and repeated advance fee tactics
user_mistake: trusted fake advisors and remote access platform
prevention: Reject unsolicited investment advisors using remote desktop / Verify regulatory registration and custody before funding
